dedupe_keys.name: dataset for testing unit commitment models of chcp plants

description: Valerio Di Felice and colleagues publish a fictional but realistic combined heat, cooling and power benchmark for unit-commitment testing. The March 2024 deposit provides 365 JSON files, one for each day of 2022, with heat and cooling demand in kilowatt-hours and electricity purchase, electricity sale and gas prices in euros per megawatt-hour. The paired deposit 10875998 supplies the block-oriented generation-plant description and explicitly links these inputs. Both downloads are free under CC BY 4.0. Together they can compare scheduling formulations on a common plant and demand year. The plant is synthetic and has no stated geographic deployment. Internal time step, plant-model schema and uncertainty remain unknown from the landing pages. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark family. Neither package was downloaded or used to reproduce an optimisation result.
